about.attempt_choice: per unit, among finished attempts: not contaminated first, then foreign_on_node mean over the timed steps at most 0.05, then the lowest foreign_on_node mean, then the latest attempt

boundaries.decode_excluded: p121 minus counted video decoding (the reference's p002 read)
boundaries.one_decode: decode_excluded plus one decode of every video on each side (clean: cv2 decode measured separately on the same videos, median pass, speedup_range over the fastest and slowest pass; paper: the reference's logged read)
boundaries.one_decode_logged: decode_excluded plus one decode of every video on each side at the reference's logged p002 read of the same run (equals one_decode on the paper side)
boundaries.one_decode_no_canvas_read: one_decode minus Tetris's canvas reads (p040 read)
boundaries.p121: p121 as published: reference decode counted, Tetris decodes not, Tetris canvas reads counted
boundaries.wall_clock: clean only: the staged prototype's stage processes, summed, one worker process at a time on one GPU, including per-process startup, so it depends on the videos per process (5 on B3D, 60 elsewhere); p022 from its log when it could not run
boundaries.wall_clock_steady: clean serial only: wall_clock with each stage's process startup taken out (first to last video's runtime write, times n / (n - 1)); the counterpart of REVISION.md finding 3's wall-clock row (r9o2's process boundary on ace)

about.measured: Throughput of the reference pipeline and of Tetris at its 5% and 10% HOTA-loss operating points, from the pipeline scripts rerun unchanged on idle Quadro RTX 6000 GPUs of bombe (NUMA-pinned), at seven timing boundaries, next to the same accounting over the paper's cached logs.
about.p022: Gurobi's license had expired, so p022 did not run: its outputs and runtime log are the cached ones (p022_source cache), and the wall clock uses its logged time (p022_wall_from_cache).

phases.parallel: all test videos while this job's three GPUs on one NUMA node ran datasets at once
phases.serial: all test videos, one unit at a time on an idle node (headline numbers)
phases.solo: calibration videos, one unit at a time on an idle node (repeatability against serial)

about.worker_counts: ProgressBar runs at most num_workers tasks of a stage at once: visible GPUs for p002, p020, p040, p060 (1 on bombe, 8 on ace), 20 for p022 and p030, 40 for p050. A Tetris stage has one task per configuration (its videos in sorted order), p002 one task per video; the clean runs ran one task at a time, the paper's runs every Pareto configuration at once.
